name: localify
description: Offline Spotify-inspired Linux desktop music player with built-in yt-dlp YouTube downloader

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite --port 5173 --strictPort" "npm run build:electron && wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron --no-sandbox ."
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer
